Definition
[Injectivity radius] \group thick-thin geometrySource: thurston:page-0132, thurston:page-0133 At $x$ in a Riemannian manifold, $\inj (x)$ is half the infimum of lengths of nontrivial closed loops through $x$, equivalently the supremum of radii on which the exponential map at $x$ is injective.
